In article <30CE6F...@udel.edu>, Chad Lubrecht <lubr...@udel.edu> wrote:
>I have a question about a situation that occured the other day.
>My predator tried to bleed me.
>I tried to block with one of my vampires who had a flak jacket.
>My predator gave his vampire +1 stealth
>Since I could not give my blocking vampire intercept, I decided to switch
>blockers and use my vampire with a sport bike.
>My predator told me I couldn't do that, that once I had chosen a blocker,
>that was the only minion who could block.
>
>Who was right? I don't remember any rule that says you can't change
>blockers but I don't have my rule book with me.
>Oh, and if it makes a difference, we were playing Jyhad, not V:TES

in Jyhad and VtES you may switch blockers as many times as you want (until
the action is blocked, of course) - even returning to a previous
would-be blocker.

Jyhad Rulebook 13.3.2
"If this [intercept >= stealth] is not the case, the blocking minion is left
untapped, and another minion may attempt to block."

VtES is not clear on this point (and even tends to refute it), but that's
only because the rules are in need of errata, not that the rules have
changed, I hope.
